scene_description: Light wood table with an open paperclip container in the middle and a capped white marker on the right. The detached black lid rests on a gray eraser on the left. Front is the open table edge; left and right are as seen facing it.

targets.name: paperclip container
targets.description: Open smoke-gray transparent paperclip container standing between the eraser on the left and the white marker on the right.
targets.clearance_notes: Sides and open rim are exposed, with ample space around the container.

candidate_improvements.description: Fit the black lid onto the paperclip container to help retain the clips during handling.

targets.other_notes: Contains loose paperclips; assembled height with the lid is 10.5 cm.

targets.name: paperclip container lid
targets.description: Black square lid with a circular opening resting on the gray eraser to the left of the open paperclip container.
targets.clearance_notes: Top and sides are exposed above the eraser.

targets.name: gray eraser
targets.description: Gray rectangular whiteboard eraser lying to the left of the paperclip container, with the black lid resting on top.
nearby_obstacles: Black paperclip container lid resting on top
targets.clearance_notes: Ends are exposed, but the black lid covers the middle of its top.

candidate_improvements.description: Lift the black lid off the eraser and fit it onto the paperclip container.

targets.name: white marker
targets.description: White dry-erase marker with a black cap lying to the right of the open paperclip container, cap pointing toward the back.
targets.clearance_notes: Barrel and cap are exposed, with open table on all sides.
